title: Sieve Helmets
description: Chainmail helmets break sand, gravel, and concrete powder that fall onto them.
body:
This pack makes sand, gravel, and concrete powder instantly break and drop as an item if they fall onto an entity wearing a chainmail helmet.

This feature [was suggested on the Minecraft subreddit](https://redd.it/1rljjd4) by user Smashpro11.
